diagrams.title: **From a sentence to function arguments

diagrams.title: **What, needs, returns
diagrams.caption: **What, needs, returns.** Write these three clearly and the agent will call your tool at the right moments with the right arguments.

diagrams.title: **Four pillars, one tools list

diagrams.title: **Fetch, compute, save

diagrams.title: **One tool, every AWS service
diagrams.caption: **One tool, every AWS service.** The model picks the service, operation and parameters; `use_aws` makes the boto3 call. Two safety gates stay in place: a confirmation for changes, and your IAM permissions.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 440" aria-label="How use_aws works. The request list all S3 buckets goes to the agent. The model fills in a use_aws call with service s3, operation list_buckets, empty parameters and region. use_aws makes that call with boto3 using your AWS credentials. Operations that create, update or delete ask for confirmation first unless consent is bypassed. IAM then decides whether the call is allowed before it reaches S3, DynamoDB or Lambda, and the result flows back." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-data" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-data" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>

diagrams.title: **Create, use, delete
diagrams.caption: **Create, use, delete.** Setup and clean-up use plain boto3 so they're predictable; only the middle part is the agent working in English.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 280" aria-label="Lifecycle of the demo resources. Step 3.0 creates an S3 bucket with sales-2024.csv, a DynamoDB customers table with customer 12345, and an order-processor Lambda function with its IAM role. Steps 3.1 to 3.4 let the agent work with them. Step 3.5 deletes all of them." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
        <rect x="20" y="30" width="330" height="220" rx="18" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
        <text x="40" y="64" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">3.0 Create (plain boto3)</text>
        <text x="40" y="104" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">S3 bucket + sales-2024.csv</text>

        <rect x="410" y="30" width="330" height="220" rx="18" class="agent" style="fill:#19203F;stroke:#19203F;stroke-width:2"></rect>
        <text x="430" y="64" class="t on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">3.1 to 3.4 The agent works</text>
